jdbcQuery.query: SELECT q.bill_cycle_code,q.account_id,q.service_agreement_id,q.premise_id,q.bill_id,q.bill_segment_id,q.bill_date,q.bill_create_date,q.bseg_create_date,q.bill_status_description,q.bseg_status_description,q.is_error_sw,q.error_reason,q.exception_type,q.recommended_action,q.event_date,q.most_recent_bill_cycle_sw FROM (WITH bill_day_volume AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') AS bill_cycle_code,TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm)) AS event_date,COUNT(DISTINCT b.acct_id) AS acct_count FROM cisadm.ci_bill b LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = b.acct_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -18) AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), ''),TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm))), cycle_anchor AS (SELECT bill_cycle_code,MAX(event_date) AS cycle_anchor_date FROM (SELECT bdv.bill_cycle_code,bdv.event_date,bdv.acct_count,MAX(bdv.acct_count) OVER (PARTITION BY bdv.bill_cycle_code) AS max_acct_count FROM bill_day_volume bdv) WHERE acct_count >= GREATEST(1, CEIL(max_acct_count * 0.80)) GROUP BY bill_cycle_code), expected_population AS (SELECT DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') AS bill_cycle_code,sa.acct_id,sa.sa_id FROM cisadm.ci_sa sa JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = sa.acct_id JOIN cycle_anchor ca ON ca.bill_cycle_code = NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') WHERE TRIM(sa.sa_status_flg) IN ('20','30') AND NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') IS NOT NULL AND (sa.start_dt IS NULL OR TRUNC(sa.start_dt) < ca.cycle_anchor_date - 7) AND (sa.end_dt IS NULL OR TRUNC(sa.end_dt) > ca.cycle_anchor_date) AND TRIM(sa.sa_type_cd) NOT IN ('EXCSCRED','DEP-RES','FEES','SSMRES','DEP-COM','SSMCOM','SSMIND','SSMPA')), actual_expected_segments AS (SELECT DISTINCT ep.bill_cycle_code,ep.sa_id FROM expected_population ep JOIN cycle_anchor ca ON ca.bill_cycle_code = ep.bill_cycle_code JOIN cisadm.ci_bseg s ON s.sa_id = ep.sa_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_bill b ON b.bill_id = s.bill_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_sa sa ON sa.sa_id = s.sa_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = NVL(b.acct_id, sa.acct_id) WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') = ep.bill_cycle_code AND TRUNC(NVL(b.cre_dttm, s.cre_dttm)) = ca.cycle_anchor_date) SELECT ep.bill_cycle_code,ep.acct_id AS account_id,ep.sa_id AS service_agreement_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS premise_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS bill_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(60)) AS bill_segment_id,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS bill_date,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS bill_create_date,CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS bseg_create_date,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS bill_status_description,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS bseg_status_description,'Y' AS is_error_sw,'Expected service agreement did not produce a matched billed segment on the anchored operational run date.' AS error_reason,'MISSING_EXPECTED_BILL' AS exception_type,'Review billing completion for the service agreement on the anchored operational run date.' AS recommended_action,ca.cycle_anchor_date AS event_date,CASE WHEN ca.cycle_anchor_date = (SELECT MAX(cycle_anchor_date) FROM cycle_anchor) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS most_recent_bill_cycle_sw FROM expected_population ep JOIN cycle_anchor ca ON ca.bill_cycle_code = ep.bill_cycle_code LEFT JOIN actual_expected_segments aes ON aes.bill_cycle_code = ep.bill_cycle_code AND aes.sa_id = ep.sa_id WHERE aes.sa_id IS NULL) q

SELECT q.bill_cycle_code,q.bill_cycle_description,q.expected_active_sa_count,q.expected_active_account_count,q.actual_billed_sa_count,q.actual_billed_account_count,q.actual_bill_segment_count,q.actual_bill_count,q.missing_active_sa_count,q.missing_active_account_count,q.cycle_last_event_date,q.most_recent_bill_cycle_sw FROM (WITH bill_day_volume AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') AS bill_cycle_code,TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm)) AS event_date,COUNT(DISTINCT b.acct_id) AS acct_count,COUNT(DISTINCT b.bill_id) AS bill_count FROM cisadm.ci_bill b LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = b.acct_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -18) AND NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), ''),TRUNC(NVL(b.bill_dt, b.cre_dttm))), cycle_anchor AS (SELECT bill_cycle_code,MAX(event_date) AS cycle_last_event_date FROM (SELECT bdv.bill_cycle_code,bdv.event_date,bdv.acct_count,MAX(bdv.acct_count) OVER (PARTITION BY bdv.bill_cycle_code) AS max_acct_count FROM bill_day_volume bdv) WHERE acct_count >= GREATEST(1, CEIL(max_acct_count * 0.80)) GROUP BY bill_cycle_code), expected_population AS (SELECT DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') AS bill_cycle_code,sa.acct_id,sa.sa_id FROM cisadm.ci_sa sa JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = sa.acct_id JOIN cycle_anchor ca ON ca.bill_cycle_code = NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') WHERE TRIM(sa.sa_status_flg) IN ('20','30') AND NULLIF(TRIM(ac.bill_cyc_cd), '') IS NOT NULL AND (sa.start_dt IS NULL OR TRUNC(sa.start_dt) < ca.cycle_last_event_date - 7) AND (sa.end_dt IS NULL OR TRUNC(sa.end_dt) > ca.cycle_last_event_date) AND TRIM(sa.sa_type_cd) NOT IN ('EXCSCRED','DEP-RES','FEES','SSMRES','DEP-COM','SSMCOM','SSMIND','SSMPA')), cycle_catalog AS (SELECT DISTINCT bill_cycle_code FROM expected_population UNION SELECT bill_cycle_code FROM cycle_anchor), expected_counts AS (SELECT bill_cycle_code,COUNT(DISTINCT sa_id) AS expected_active_sa_count,COUNT(DISTINCT acct_id) AS expected_active_account_count FROM expected_population GROUP BY bill_cycle_code), actual_expected_segments AS (SELECT ep.bill_cycle_code,ep.acct_id,ep.sa_id,s.bseg_id,b.bill_id FROM expected_population ep JOIN cycle_anchor ca ON ca.bill_cycle_code = ep.bill_cycle_code JOIN cisadm.ci_bseg s ON s.sa_id = ep.sa_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_bill b ON b.bill_id = s.bill_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_sa sa ON sa.sa_id = s.sa_id LEFT JOIN cisadm.ci_acct ac ON ac.acct_id = NVL(b.acct_id, sa.acct_id) WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(NVL(b.bill_cyc_cd, ac.bill_cyc_cd)), '') = ep.bill_cycle_code AND TRUNC(NVL(b.cre_dttm, s.cre_dttm)) = ca.cycle_last_event_date), actual_counts AS (SELECT ca.bill_cycle_code,ca.cycle_last_event_date,COUNT(DISTINCT aes.sa_id) AS actual_billed_sa_count,COUNT(DISTINCT aes.acct_id) AS actual_billed_account_count,COUNT(DISTINCT aes.bseg_id) AS actual_bill_segment_count,COUNT(DISTINCT aes.bill_id) AS actual_bill_count FROM cycle_anchor ca LEFT JOIN actual_expected_segments aes ON aes.bill_cycle_code = ca.bill_cycle_code GROUP BY ca.bill_cycle_code,ca.cycle_last_event_date), cycle_desc AS (SELECT TRIM(bill_cyc_cd) AS bill_cycle_code,MAX(descr) AS bill_cycle_description FROM cisadm.ci_bill_cyc_l WHERE language_cd IN ('ENG','EN') GROUP BY TRIM(bill_cyc_cd)) SELECT c.bill_cycle_code,NVL(d.bill_cycle_description,'Cycle ' || c.bill_cycle_code) AS bill_cycle_description,NVL(e.expected_active_sa_count,0) AS expected_active_sa_count,NVL(e.expected_active_account_count,0) AS expected_active_account_count,NVL(a.actual_billed_sa_count,0) AS actual_billed_sa_count,NVL(a.actual_billed_account_count,0) AS actual_billed_account_count,NVL(a.actual_bill_segment_count,0) AS actual_bill_segment_count,NVL(a.actual_bill_count,0) AS actual_bill_count,GREATEST(NVL(e.expected_active_sa_count,0)-NVL(a.actual_billed_sa_count,0),0) AS missing_active_sa_count,GREATEST(NVL(e.expected_active_account_count,0)-NVL(a.actual_billed_account_count,0),0) AS missing_active_account_count,a.cycle_last_event_date,CASE WHEN a.cycle_last_event_date = MAX(a.cycle_last_event_date) OVER () THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS most_recent_bill_cycle_sw FROM cycle_catalog c LEFT JOIN expected_counts e ON e.bill_cycle_code = c.bill_cycle_code LEFT JOIN actual_counts a ON a.bill_cycle_code = c.bill_cycle_code LEFT JOIN cycle_desc d ON d.bill_cycle_code = c.bill_cycle_code WHERE c.bill_cycle_code IS NOT NULL) q
